name: Payment Method Discounts
author: Steam Verde

sections.description:
This plugin allows you to add discounts for specific payment methods in WooCommerce. You can set fixed amounts or percentages for each payment method. The discount is applied automatically at checkout without interfering with coupon discounts.

Este plugin permite que você adicione descontos para métodos de pagamento específicos no WooCommerce. Você pode definir valores fixos ou porcentagens para cada método de pagamento. O desconto é aplicado automaticamente no checkout conforme configurado no painel admin, sem interferir nos descontos de cupons.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/payment-method-discounts directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.

  3. Go to “WooCommerce > Payment Discounts” in the admin menu to configure discounts for each payment method.

  4. Carregue os arquivos do plugin para o diretório /wp-content/plugins/payment-method-discounts ou instale o plugin diretamente pela tela de plugins do WordPress.

  5. Ative o plugin pela tela ‘Plugins’ no WordPress.
  6. Vá para “WooCommerce > Descontos de pagamento” no menu do administrador para configurar descontos para cada método de pagamento.
sections.faq:
Can I use this plugin with other discount plugins?

Yes, this plugin does not interfere with other discount plugins or WooCommerce coupons.

How do I set a percentage discount?

Enter the percentage followed by the % symbol (e.g., 5%).

How do I set a fixed discount?

Enter the fixed amount (e.g., 10).
